records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Checking in on how Vantage Studio is settling into Wrenfield. If anything feels clunky or confusing, I'd genuinely like to hear about it.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Vantage Studio set up
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to either outreach ([email:1b2474f9], [email:07013703]). No tickets or any engagement signal; silent Starter accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

I know a new tool can slip down the list in a busy week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so getting one project up is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how Vantage Studio works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
